Context: 5. Procedure Minor Penalties.-

In cases under Category (1), the Disciplinary Authority has to peruse the judgment of the Criminal Court and take into account the gravity of the misconduct committed, its impact on the administration and other extenuating circumstances or redeeming features. Once it is concluded that the Government servant's conduct is blameworthy and punishable, it may impose such penalty as it is competent to do.
